name: rounD: Roundabout Drone Trajectory Dataset
description: Naturalistic traffic trajectory dataset captured by aerial drones over three distinct roundabouts in Germany, recording 13,500 road users to benchmark circular motion modeling, gap acceptance, and multi-vehicle yielding behaviors.

license.name: levelXData Non-Commercial Academic License
license.notes: Freely accessible for non-commercial academic research upon registration with levelXData.

source_references.title: rounD Dataset Official Portal
source_references.notes: Official portal containing dataset description, roundabout site layout diagrams, and access registration.

source_references.title: The rounD Dataset: A Large-Scale Naturalistic Trajectory Dataset of Roundabout Traffic for Verification of Automated Driving Systems
source_references.notes: IEEE ITSC 2020 publication by Krajewski et al. documenting the roundabout trajectory benchmark.

verification.notes: Verified against levelXData rounD portal and IEEE ITSC 2020 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ITSC45102.2020.9294424).

size.notes: levelXData distributes individual CSV files per recording after academic registration approval; a single fixed aggregate archive size is not officially published.

citation.paper_title: The rounD Dataset: A Large-Scale Naturalistic Trajectory Dataset of Roundabout Traffic for Verification of Automated Driving Systems

provenance.collection_method: Recorded from camera-equipped aerial drones stationed above three distinctive roundabouts in Germany.
provenance.curation_notes: Contains 13,500 road user trajectories covering 6 hours of recordings, focusing on circular motion dynamics, entry gap acceptance, and multi-lane yielding decisions.
